description.value: Butchers Block BBQ is a family-owned backyard-style barbecue restaurant in Burnaby Heights, slow-smoking beef brisket, pulled pork, ribs, pork belly, and sausages daily with house-made rubs and sauces. Operating since 2005, it has earned recognition including Vancouver Magazine's 'Best Barbecue' award and multiple 'Best of Burnaby' honours. Cyclists on the Hastings Street corridor can fuel up with generous platters or grab takeout via phone or online order.
